categories.label: Formulas and mathematical notation
categories.review: Check every symbol, grouping, blank entry and source error; LaTeX is presentation, not executable semantics.

categories.label: Angles, triangles and intersecting/parallel lines
categories.review: Preserve labels and explicit givens; never infer lengths, parallelism or right angles from appearance.

categories.label: Reflection and translation constructions
categories.review: Separate stated transformations from approximate drawing coordinates.

categories.label: Shapes, symmetry and geometric patterns
categories.review: Preserve shape boundaries, labels and symmetry markings.

categories.label: Coordinate-plane diagrams
categories.review: Record axes, scales, units and labelled points; do not infer an exact function from a curve.

categories.label: Rotations and circular point arrangements
categories.review: Check centre, orientation, arc direction and stated angles.

categories.label: Matrices with labels, boxes or arrows
categories.review: Transcribe entries separately from the explanatory layout; preserve blanks.

categories.label: Directed network graphs
categories.review: Check every node, directed edge, loop and parallel edge independently of the layout.

categories.label: Annotated calculation flow
categories.review: Preserve expressions, arrow direction and explanatory labels.

categories.label: Street grids and maps
categories.review: Record connectivity separately from geographic or drawing positions.

categories.label: Calculator and software screenshots
categories.review: Keep the screenshot; transcribe visible keys, screen text and instructions.

categories.label: Data tables
categories.review: Check cell contents, merged headers, units, footnotes and blanks.

categories.label: Text embedded in an image
categories.review: Check transcription against the source, including formatting that carries meaning.

categories.label: Mixed or compound figure
categories.review: Split into linked component regions before converting; preserve the parent layout.

categories.label: Scanned page requiring segmentation
categories.review: Locate all figures and text on the page before attempting category conversions.

categories.label: Photographs and illustrations
categories.review: Keep the original; add a useful description without invented details.

categories.label: Decorative marks
categories.review: Confirm that the mark carries no mathematical or instructional content.

categories.label: Needs classification
categories.review: Inspect the source and surrounding question; use mixed when a single category would lose meaning.
